pages.title: Wprowadzenie
pages.text: The $(l:beneath)Beneath$() hosts its own unique selection of wild fruits, which have adapted to the extreme conditions underground. Wild fruits can be cultivated in all the same ways as regular $(l:the_world/wild_fruits)wild fruits$() in the Overworld.

$(bold)$(l:the_world/climate#temperature)Temperature$(): 8 - 80 °C$(br)$(bold)$(l:agriculture/growing_crops#hydration)Hydration$(): 20 - 100 %$(br2)Lavacado trees grow in the months of December through April, start flowering in May and June, and bear fruit in July.
pages.title: Lawokado

pages.text: Dzikie drzewa lawacado można znaleźć pomiędzy Y=198 i Y=60.

pages.title: Palm Fruit Trees

pages.text: $(bold)$(l:the_world/climate#temperature)Temperature$(): 19 - 62 °C$(br)$(bold)$(l:agriculture/growing_crops#hydration)Hydration$(): 10 - 100 %$(br2)Oil Palm trees are harvested for their fruits which can be processed into Palm Oil and a source of burlap fiber. Oil palm clusters grow in 4 stages and yield 3-6 items when harvested.
pages.title: Oil Palm Tree

pages.text: Oil palm trees can be found in $(thing)Salt Caves$() and $(thing)Tar Pools$() biomes between Y=50 and Y=190
